coreLoop: Enter a short competitive encounter, read opponent movement, and use movement, attacks, aim, abilities, or combos to create an advantage.
Damage or eliminate opponents, receive clear hit and score feedback, then reposition around cooldowns, cover, objectives, or team pressure.
Complete the round or score target, receive progression or loadout rewards, and re-enter a new match with a changed tactical choice or mastery goal.

signatureSystems.name: Combat
signatureSystems.purpose: Create an engaging and immersive combat experience that challenges players to outmaneuver their opponents and use their skills to gain an advantage.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Players can choose to engage in a variety of combat styles, such as melee, ranged, or close-quarters combat, to suit their preferred playstyle and enhance their chances of success.

signatureSystems.name: Opponent
signatureSystems.purpose: Create a dynamic and unpredictable opponent system that challenges players to adapt to their opponents' strategies and tactics.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Opponents can be customized with unique abilities, skills, and movement patterns to provide a constantly evolving and challenging experience.

signatureSystems.name: Skill
signatureSystems.purpose: Create a system that rewards players for mastering specific skills, such as dodging, evading, or using specific abilities, to enhance their overall performance.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Players can unlock and unlock skills that improve their abilities to defeat opponents and progress in the game.

signatureSystems.name: Cooldown
signatureSystems.purpose: Create a system that limits players' ability to use certain abilities or move around the map, providing a sense of urgency and challenge.
signatureSystems.playerChoice: Players can strategically use their cooldowns to avoid being caught off guard or to take advantage of their opponents' mistakes.
